notes: URLs are paths relative to the origin the site is served from (node bench/serve.mjs).

A control page has no page-scope defect. Site-scope defects (robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemaps, /.well-known files, the /services/ firewall rule) apply to the whole origin and are not counted against controls.

found_on is the page that links to the defective URL; tools may legitimately report the defect at either url or found_on. alt_types lists other reasonable names for the same planted problem (or its direct consequence) that should match this defect rather than count as false positives.
The site is served over plain HTTP on localhost. HTTPS, HSTS-over-HTTP and mixed-content findings are environmental and are not planted defects.
verify holds machine-checkable assertions used by bench/verify-ground-truth.mjs.

defects.description: Icon-only button has no accessible name (no text, aria-label or title).
Clinic page uses robots nosnippet, which stops search engines (including Google AI Overviews / AI Mode) from quoting any of its text.
Page advertises a Markdown version for AI agents via <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"> but that URL returns 404.
FAQ page sets max-snippet:0, which forbids search engines (including Google AI features) from showing any text from it, the page most useful for answers.
The price list, the main content of the page, is only loaded by JavaScript from /api/prices.json; the HTML response contains "Loading prices…" and no prices.

All main content, including the H1, is rendered in the browser from /data/stories.json; the HTML response contains only an empty <div id="app"> and a "please enable JavaScript" message. AI crawlers that do not run JavaScript see nothing.
GPTBot is disallowed from the whole site, although llms.txt says the practice welcomes AI assistants using its content.
PerplexityBot (the crawler that indexes pages for Perplexity answers) is disallowed from the whole site, so the practice cannot appear in Perplexity search results.
ChatGPT-User (fetches pages when a ChatGPT user asks about them) is disallowed from the whole site.
ClaudeBot is disallowed from /team/, hiding all clinician biographies (the authorship and expertise pages) from Anthropic’s crawler while the rest of the site is allowed.
llms.txt does not start with the required H1 (the site or project name); it begins with a blockquote.
defects.evidence: First line: "> Harbourline Dental Studio is an independent…"; no line starting "# ".

Browsers and Googlebot get 200.

defects.description: LocalBusiness (Dentist) markup carries an aggregateRating about the business itself on its own site, which Google treats as self-serving and ineligible; no reviews are shown on the page.

JSON-LD block is not valid JSON (trailing comma, missing closing brace) so no structured data can be read.
Article has no author: no byline on the page and no author in the BlogPosting JSON-LD.
Article shows no publication or update date and its BlogPosting JSON-LD has no datePublished/dateModified.
Blog article has no structured data at all (no Article/BlogPosting, no BreadcrumbList), unlike every other article.
BlogPosting datePublished is free text, not an ISO 8601 date.
Long article (about 560 words in eight paragraphs) has no subheadings at all, so it cannot be scanned or split into passages.
Event structured data ends before it starts (endDate 16:00 is earlier than startDate 18:00), contradicting the visible 6pm–8pm.
BlogPosting dateModified (2025-02-01) is earlier than datePublished (2026-08-04).
BreadcrumbList ListItems have no "position", a required property.

defects.description: A tab widget is built from clickable <span>s with no tab/tablist/tabpanel roles, no focusability and no aria-selected, so agents and assistive tech cannot see or operate it.

The page registers a WebMCP tool whose inputSchema is not valid JSON Schema ("type": "objekt", property type "date", "required" as a string).
Form fields use invalid autocomplete tokens ("e-mail", "phone"), so browsers and agents cannot identify the fields' purpose (WCAG 1.3.5).
defects.evidence: autocomplete="e-mail" and autocomplete="phone" (valid tokens are "email" and "tel").
